newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish April trade surplus 886 million DKK.
newsitem.headline: Danish April trade surplus 886 million DKK.

text.p: Denmark posted a trade surplus excluding ships of 886 million crowns in April 1997, the national statistics office said on Wednesday.

It compared to a revised 2.278 billion crowns surplus in March. Seasonally adjusted the surplus excluding ships was 1.512 billion crowns in April, compared to March's revised 1.724 billion crowns. DANISH TRADE (billions of crowns):
NOTE - Nine analysts polled by Reuters forecast an average seasonally-adjusted April trade surplus excl. ships of 2.9 billion crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969652
